entities.name: Raúl Pérez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raúl Norberto Pérez is an Argentine rugby union former player and coach of the Argentine Super Rugby side, the Jaguares. He is currently the head coach of Paraguay national rugby union team. He played as a flanker. He worked as a systems analyst and programmer.
